description: Ordered acyclic identity stages. SPEC sections 4 and 5.
acyclicity: Each stage binds only EARLIER stage identities. No stage contains its own identity. MANIFEST.json is the canonical encoding of OutputManifestBody and its own digest is never in its own preimage.

files.justification: SPEC 7.1's SpecMachine exposes ONE Fault used by both decode and initial. Binary and Config own genuinely different failure sets under SPEC 7.1's ownership rule, so the unified type needs its own module. Both injections proved injective, images proved disjoint.

Hardening. Proves the seal's cover check is blind to the byte universe, so it cannot be cited as universal coverage (claim AT-001, falsifier M7).
